csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using System.Linq; using System.IO; public class Script { public static void Main() { var all = Object.FindObjectsByType<GameObject>(FindObjectsInactive.Include, FindObjectsSortMode.None); var hs = all.Where(go => go.name.Contains("Highway_8000")).OrderBy(go => go.name).ToList(); var lines = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>(); foreach (var go in hs) { var mf = go.GetComponent<MeshFilter>(); string o = go.name + " : "; if (mf != null && mf.sharedMesh != null) { var b = mf.sharedMesh.bounds; o += "center=" + go.transform.TransformPoint(b.center).ToString("F0") + " size=" + go.transform.TransformVector(b.size).ToString("F0"); } else { o += "no mesh"; } lines.Add(o); } File.WriteAllLines("C:/Zombera/highway_bounds.txt", lines); } }
